name: hx-lua-simdjson
description: Fast simdjson-backed JSON parsing for the Haxe Lua target. Adding this library transparently routes haxe.Json.parse through the native hxsimdjson luarock via a build macro.
releasenote: Initial haxelib release: extern binding plus a build macro that redirects haxe.format.JsonParser to simdjson on the Lua target (no std shadowing).
